name: Camping 101: Cooking

angles.text: Cooking teaches you to build basic campfires at the heart of your camps in the wild.
As an Alliance adventurer new to Elwynn Forest, you are directed to Cook Tomas at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire to learn cooking and campfire building.

faq.answer: Cooking teaches you to build a basic campfire for a campsite in the wild.
faq.q: What is the quest Camping 101: Cooking?

faq.answer: Tomas teaches cooking in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest. Find him at the Lion's Pride Inn, where he teaches the basics of cooking and lighting a campfire.
faq.q: Who is Tomas and where can he be found?

aliases: why do i need cooking for camping
faq.answer: Cooking teaches you to build the campfire at the heart of a wilderness camp, where you can rest and arrange furnishings.
faq.q: Why is cooking required to establish a campsite?

faq.answer: Greater cooking skill lets you build larger, sturdier fires for your camp in the wild.
faq.q: Can you make larger campfires as your skill improves?

aliases: where do camp furnishings come from
faq.answer: Other tradeskill trainers teach you ways to make campsite furnishings. Different crafting trades let you create items to decorate and improve a camp in the wild.
faq.q: How do you acquire furnishings for your campsite?

faq.answer: Once you know how to cook and build a campfire, you can make camp in the open wilderness. Your first campsites are modest and hold only a few furnishings until you expand your skills.
faq.q: Where can an adventurer set up camp?

sections.body: A campfire gives you a place to prepare food and begin a camp in Azeroth's wilds. Learn to cook, and you learn to build that fire. Then an open stretch of wilderness can become a place to camp.
sections.title: The Hearth in the Wild

sections.body: In Elwynn Forest, new travelers find Cook Tomas in Goldshire and learn the craft. His instruction gives you the skill to make a basic camp in the wild. At first, your camp holds few furnishings. Greater cooking skill lets you build larger fires, while other crafting trades give you more ways to furnish and shape your campsite.
sections.title: Instruction in Goldshire

summary: In Goldshire, Cook Tomas shows new travelers how cooking kindles a campfire. With that fire, they can make a simple camp in the wild.
